split: Week 1 seed-42 split; training subsets are train_indices[:n]; official test set evaluated once after all final runs
model_selection: epoch with the lowest validation loss
hypotheses: H1: Without dropout, the gap between training and validation accuracy grows as the training set gets smaller.
H2: Dropout reduces that gap at every training size.
H3: Dropout lowers the within-group confusion rate for T-shirt/top, pullover, coat and shirt, and the reduction is larger at 10,000 images than at 2,000 images.
H4: The test-accuracy gain from dropout depends on training-set size.
analysis_plan: For each training size and each dropout rate above 0, compare with dropout 0.0 paired by seed (10 pairs): mean difference, 95% t confidence interval, paired t-test, Holm correction across the 8 comparisons per metric. H3 compares the dropout effect at 2,000 vs 10,000 with Welch's t-test. Every condition is reported.
